stories.title: Cambridge Dictionary unveils its word of the year
stories.simple_summary: Cambridge Dictionary picks one word each year that shows what people are talking about most. This year they chose a word that reflects what's on everyone's mind.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just interesting trivia. It doesn't affect your life or business.

stories.title: A.I. Mistook a Bag of Chips for a Gun, Teenagers’ Lawsuit Says
stories.simple_summary: An AI camera system made a serious mistake. It thought a bag of snack chips was a gun, and teenagers are suing because of what happened as a result.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI security systems can make dangerous mistakes. If you use AI cameras or security tools, you should know they're not perfect yet.

stories.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future  deals in doubt
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia invested billions of dollars in startup companies, but the company's leader just left suddenly. Now people wonder if Nvidia will keep making these deals.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and technology companies. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia says its money coming in will keep growing very fast, even though the company just lost its leader.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Satya Nadella says he’s AGI-pilled now
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft's leader is saying he believes AI will completely change how businesses work and how governments should be organized.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly his opinion about the future. Right now it doesn't directly affect your business or life.

stories.title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia says it will stop selling computer chips to China, a major market change that will cost the company a lot of money.
stories.why_it_matters: This is big for technology and global trade. If you don't work in tech, this doesn't affect your daily life.

stories.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia says it will keep supporting open source AI projects, meaning AI tools that anyone can see and modify, despite losing its leader.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies and engineers. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Nvidia: China fears Jensen Huang scandal could shut it out of US AI tech before Xi-Trump summit
stories.simple_summary: China is worried that problems at Nvidia might stop Chinese companies from getting access to important American AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a government and business story between countries. It doesn't affect your personal life.

stories.title: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's former leader asked if he could come back as CEO, but the company said no.
stories.why_it_matters: This is company news that matters mostly to Nvidia employees and investors. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
stories.simple_summary: Amazon and Google together will own nearly 30 percent of Anthropic, an AI company, after it goes public. This means these big companies own large pieces of this AI business.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors. It shows big tech companies are buying up AI companies, but it doesn't change how you use these services.

stories.title: Is SK Hynix the Better Artificial Intelligence (AI) Memory Stock Compared With Micron?
stories.simple_summary: This is a comparison of two computer chip companies to help investors decide which one might make more money from AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is for people thinking about investing in stocks. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
stories.simple_summary: Federal investigators are looking into Nvidia because its leader admitted to having an affair with someone connected to China.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a legal investigation of a big company. Unless you work there or own Nvidia stock, it doesn't affect you.
